meta.title: Create speed benchmark for execute_sequence
meta.body_summary: Add an ignored integration test that benchmarks execute_sequence wall-clock time against a real website, comparing client-side elapsed time with agent-reported duration.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added a benchmark test with detailed metrics; bot flagged a potential unsafe integer cast but maintainer merged within ~14 minutes without fix.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 176 new lines in a single ignored test file, this is a small addition by absolute volume. It fits a quick infrastructure PR and merged rapidly without blocking review.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] BugBot flagged that the assertion `reported_ms as u128 <= elapsed.as_millis()` performs an unsafe cast from i64 to u128; a negative reported_ms would wrap to a huge value, leading to confusing assertion failures.
review_details.performance_claim: Provides a reproducible wall-clock benchmark comparing execute_sequence client-side elapsed time with agent-reported duration.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor added a benchmark test but introduced a potential unsafe integer cast in the assertion logic; the bot detection exposed a gap in Rust type-safety handling during test generation.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor[bot] identified the negative-value cast bug via static analysis during formal review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Benchmark test is #[ignore]d; requires graphical environment and browser; target URL customizable via MCP_BENCH_TARGET_URL; no actual timing data provided in PR.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: BugBot flagged unsafe u128 cast; PR merged without addressing the suggestion.

core_change_summary.description: Added an ignored integration test `execute_sequence_benchmark.rs` that launches an MCP agent, navigates to a Selenium demo form, and compares wall-clock elapsed time with the agent's reported duration, providing detailed performance metrics.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (b5dfda1): added benchmark test with navigation and timing assertions.
Second commit (d5f0fe7): updated test to use Selenium demo form and enriched metrics output.

review_signals.summary: BugBot identified a potential wrap-around when casting i64 to u128 if reported_ms is negative, causing misleading assertion failures.

collaboration_trajectory: BugBot review appeared shortly after PR creation; maintainer merged quickly without further interaction.
